position_method: chip centroid on the 96 dpi map raster strips
identification_method: visual typology: symbol fill colour + body size + printed code letter
notes: Symbols are rasterised in the PDF at 96 dpi; code letters are 4-6 px high.
436 of 793 symbols are resolved to a mineral; the rest keep their measured
colour and body size so they can be matched against the printed legend by hand.
Colour alone is not identifying: e.g. the yellow family contains Gold, Clay,
Pyrite, Glass Sand, Brine and Dimension Stone.
